text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6e78

g.text: V128 native/oMLX used HTTP/SSE; V130 Lithos used official Ollama NDJSON. Independent campaigns: descriptive comparison, not paired.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6e78

g.text: Native C1 = CAP64/direct ICB; native C2/C4 = accepted25 batching/CAP256. Lithos = one generation at a time with FIFO queuing.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6e78

g.text: Latency includes server queuing. Per-group request p50 → median of 3 formal groups → median of 3 fresh arms; throughput uses the same hierarchy.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6e78

g.text: Filled large marks are non-dominated within these 9 points. Guides connect observed C levels only; no interpolated feasibility or statistical significance claim.
